findings.title: Refactor moves pluginId/endpoint/uname/ds labels from explicit log params to FromContext with no test
findings.body: Before this PR the "Plugin Request Completed" log line explicitly added pluginId, endpoint, uname (dsName/dsUID) and traceID from the request's PluginContext. Those explicit params were deleted; the line now depends entirely on the contextual attributes added by the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware being read back through m.logger.FromContext(ctx). If the middleware ordering, the WithContextualAttributes plumbing, or the grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext type-assertion ever fails, these labels silently disappear from the log line and nothing detects it. No test covers this path (the renamed metrics test only checks Prometheus metrics), so this behavior change is unverified. At minimum a test should wrap the logger middleware with a logger that records FromContext output and assert pluginId/endpoint/labels are present.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards context, making the new FromContext-based logging path untestable
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext ignores its context.Context argument and returns a brand-new empty TestLogger. The refactored LoggerMiddleware now obtains contextual attributes exclusively via FromContext, so any test using this fake can never observe whether the attributes were actually propagated. The fake silently masks exactly the behavior this PR introduces. It should copy/record the contextual attributes from the context (or the log call should include them) so tests can assert the merged output.

findings.title: Test function still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware after rename
findings.body: The file and symbol were renamed from Instrumentation to Metrics, but the test function is still `func TestInstrumentationMiddleware`. This leaves the rename inconsistent and makes the test hard to locate by name; it should be renamed to TestMetricsMiddleware.
